title: API SetAbandonQuest
wikitext:
Called before calling [[API AbandonQuest|AbandonQuest]]
 SetAbandonQuest();
----

; ''Arguments''

: ''none''

----

; ''Returns''

:; nil

----

; ''Example''

 SetAbandonQuest();

; ''Result''

----

; ''Description''

: Called before calling [[API AbandonQuest|AbandonQuest]]. Found in OnClick event of the Abandon Quest button of the default interface file QuestLogFrame.xml

== Macros ==
Abandon all the quests in your quest log<syntaxhighlight lang="lua">
/run for i=1,GetNumQuestLogEntries() do SelectQuestLogEntry(i); SetAbandonQuest(); AbandonQuest(); end
</syntaxhighlight>



== Addons ==
Example from TitanQuest plugin for Titan<syntaxhighlight lang="lua">
			-- abandon quest
			info = {};
			info.value = "AbandonQuest";
			info.text = ABANDON_QUEST;
			info.func = function ()	
					DropDownList1:Hide();				
					SetAbandonQuest();
                			StaticPopup_Show("ABANDON_QUEST", GetAbandonQuestName());
			end
</syntaxhighlight>
